purpose: admit zero, one, or multiple externally completed blinded reviewer bundles into a fail-closed collection receipt before the frozen unanimous multi-reviewer consensus gate

collection_states.WAITING_FOR_FIRST_REVIEWER: no admissible reviewer bundle has been received; this is an expected external-dependency state, not a software failure
collection_states.WAITING_FOR_SECOND_REVIEWER: exactly one admissible reviewer bundle has been received; consensus remains blocked
collection_states.READY_FOR_CONSENSUS: at least two admissible distinct reviewer bundles are bound to the frozen package and the consensus core preflight passes
collection_states.INVALID_COLLECTION: one or more submitted artifacts fail integrity, attestation, package-binding, verifier-binding, reviewer-distinctness, or consensus-core preflight checks

cross_reviewer_admission.reason_completed_review_form_hashes_may_: two genuinely independent reviewers can legitimately produce byte-identical completed CSV files when every categorical label and review_notes field are identical; forcing inequality would create a false independence criterion
cross_reviewer_admission.reason_disagreement_is_not_an_admission_: valid independent reviewers are allowed to disagree; the downstream consensus gate preserves non-unanimous cells as DISAGREEMENT rather than rejecting or imputing them

software_can_establish: completed review form hash binding across attestation, analysis and verifier
reviewer-declared label freeze before model reveal
software_cannot_establish: absence of undisclosed prior exposure outside the submitted attestation

waiting_state_exit_semantics: WAITING_FOR_FIRST_REVIEWER and WAITING_FOR_SECOND_REVIEWER are successful machine states that preserve an unmet external dependency; they must not be converted into INVALID_COLLECTION or a fabricated biological result
invalid_state_semantics: INVALID_COLLECTION is fail-closed and must block consensus until the invalid artifacts are replaced or corrected without mutating any already frozen valid submission
software_fixture_policy: CI may synthesize reviewer bundles only to test collection-state transitions and fail-closed checks. Synthetic bundles are never real reviewer submissions or biological evidence.
claim_ceiling: This protocol establishes a machine-verifiable pre-consensus collection boundary only. READY_FOR_CONSENSUS means the supplied artifacts are structurally and cryptographically admissible for the exact frozen submission protocol and consensus implementation; it does not prove human independence, CatFACS competence, EAD onset truth, mimicry, feline latency, population-level behavior, or INDEPENDENT_FRAME_LEVEL_ESTIMATE.
